title: fraga sterilis
intro: Fraga sterilis, commonly known as wild garlic, is a perennial plant belonging to the Allium family. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Fraga sterilis include acting as an antimicrobial, antiviral, and antioxidant, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as allicin, alliin, and quercetin. These compounds contribute to its ability to reduce oxidative stress, improve cognitive function, and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal issues.
